newsitem.title: CAMEROON: Cameroon signs letter of intent with IMF.
newsitem.headline: Cameroon signs letter of intent with IMF.

text.p: The government of Cameroon said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent with the International Monetary Fund which should lead to a speedy disbursement of funds by various donors.
"The signing of this letter of intent is a new lease to economic recovery to our country," Prime Minister Peter Mafany Musonge said.

Certain conditions still have to be met by the government, but a full, three-year Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility should be agreed by the IMF, perhaps as early as next month, donor sources said.
